ModMetaData.name: RimWorld AI Modding Toolkit
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description: A generic, agent-driven RimWorld modding toolkit. Exposes the base game and DLC surface to an external AI agent over a simple file-based tool bridge: discover and invoke in-game dev/inspection tools (defs, incidents, debug actions, pawn/object/map state) and let other mods register their own tools dynamically. Forked from the RimSynapse Core tool bridge, stripped of narrative content and local-LLM assumptions. Requires Harmony.
